pr.title: README: name the pinned Archon revision (24796870)
pr.body:
The README's status paragraph named `a02b9ab6`, but `template/factory/pack.json` pins `24796870605b0fd576734b79a8d5c781f2b1c1e1`, which is what `init` installs and what every validation since 9/16 ran on. One-line fix so the Berlin attendees (and everyone else) read the same pin the installer uses.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
